stories.summary: CNBC reports that investors may want to focus on the front end of the yield curve as markets position for the Federal Reserve's next policy meetings. Short-dated Treasury yields are seen as the most sensitive to near-term rate expectations.
stories.whyItMatters: The front end of the curve reflects real-time bets on Fed policy, making it a key gauge for anyone positioning around upcoming rate decisions.

stories.title: Stocks end July on hopeful note after historic momentum-trade unwind
stories.summary: MarketWatch reports that the momentum trade suffered its biggest wipeout since 2000, yet stocks finished July on a more hopeful note. The unwind of crowded momentum positions had weighed on markets earlier in the month.
stories.whyItMatters: A momentum unwind of this scale can signal a painful rotation for investors heavily positioned in high-flying stocks, with ripple effects across portfolios.
